title: WikiLeaks email: Hillary Clinton asks about Gilgamesh's tomb

tellings.quote: Remember there was allegedly an email that was a correspondence with Hillary Clinton where she was inquiring about the resurrection tomb and body of Gilgamesh.

plain: The claim is that an email made public by WikiLeaks, a website that publishes leaked documents, shows the American politician Hillary Clinton asking about the tomb and body of Gilgamesh, a king from ancient Iraqi legend, along with talk of resurrection. The researcher and filmmaker Tim Alberino brings it up without naming a source, and he calls it an email that "allegedly" exists, linked to 2016. He raises it to suggest that powerful people care about ancient remains in Iraq.
